Command: Levites shall not perform priestly service
Summary: The command: Levites shall not perform priestly service (Numbers 18:3). The Levites kept the charge of the tabernacle but might not come near the vessels of the sanctuary or the altar, lest they die.
Commandment: Levites shall not perform priestly service.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: the priesthood was given to Aaron and his sons; the Levites kept the charge of the tabernacle but might not approach the altar, lest they die (Numbers 18:3).
